formula: U_AB = E · d_AB   (champ uniforme, d projeté sur E)
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with two parallel plate electrodes (+ / −),
voltage slider U (V), plate separation slider d (cm). Canvas2D
overlay draws uniform E-field arrows between the plates
(|E| = U/d, direction + → −). A draggable test charge shows a force
arrow F = qE. HUD: U, d, |E| (V/m), q (nC), |F|. Experiment: reach
a target |E| by choosing U, d. Evaluate: hide the field overlay,
keep plates; student sets U and d to place a hidden test charge at
a target displacement inside the capacitor (via F=qE and one step of
kinematics). Wrinkle: uniform field is a slab approximation — no
fringe effects.
